module modular_add_cipher (
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output [7:0] data_out
);

wire [7:0] c;

assign data_out[0] = data_in[0] ^ 1'b1;         // Sum0 = data_in[0] +1 mod2 → XOR with1
assign c[0] = data_in[0] & 1'b1;                // Carry from bit0

genvar i;
generate
for (i=1; i<8; i=i+1) begin : adder
    assign data_out[i] = data_in[i] ^ c[i-1];    // Sum_i = data_in[i] +c[i-1] mod2
    assign c[i] = data_in[i] & c[i-1];          // Carry from previous stage
end
endgenerate

endmodule

    input  [3:0] B,   // Second BCD number (0-9)

    output [3:0] Sum, // BCD sum (0-9)
    output Cout       // Output carry
);
    wire [4:0] sum_total = A + B + Cin;
    wire [5:0] shift_total = { {1'b0, sum_total}, 1'b0 }; // Zero-extend to 6 bits for shift
    wire [5:0] shifted = shift_total << 1; // Shift left by 1 to adjust sum and carry
    wire [4:0] sum_total_adj = shifted[5:1]; // Take upper 5 bits after adjustment

    assign Sum = sum_total_adj[3:0]; // Lower 4 bits as BCD sum
    assign Cout = sum_total_adj[4];   // Carry-out from the adjusted total
endmodule

module parallel2serial(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input [3:0] d,
    output valid_out,
    output dout
);

reg [3:0] stored_data;
reg valid_out_reg;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        stored_data <= 4'b0;
        valid_out_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (valid_out_reg) begin
            if (stored_data == 4'b1111)  // Check if current stored data is 15
                valid_out_reg <= 1'b0;  // Reset valid_out after 4 cycles
            else
                stored_data <= d;      // Update stored_data with new input
        end else begin
            valid_out_reg <= 1'b1;     // Assert valid_out after 1 cycle
        end
    end
end

assign dout = (rst_n) ? stored_data[3] : 1'b0;  // LSB has priority (stored_data[0])

endmodule
